frontend_only: Metric counts calculated from loaded records
Calendar layout from lesson timestamps and declared availability; server remains authoritative for reservations
Progress stages drawn from plan stage status; no invented rubric scores
Filters, sorting, tabs, initial avatars and date formatting
Day / night themes, hover light, AI animations and reduced motion
Multiple cards reuse the same cached records; no card-specific API
Entry links and suggested next steps are derived from the current workflow state
not_in_scope: Teacher assignment CRUD, submission versions, grading and resubmission workflows
Generated periodic learning reports and downloadable report service
Notifications, reminders, notification unread counts and read-state APIs
Payments, invoices, learning partners and pronunciation scoring
Cost / token dashboards or invented activity analytics
Global search service, multiple concurrent learning-direction management and recruitment administration
Manual run / retry buttons that add an unnecessary public infrastructure API
state_rules: Low-confidence results remain provisional until the assigned teacher confirms or corrects them.
An initial or major revised plan activates after one teacher approval; no second student plan approval.
Light practice records feedback without changing a formal assessment or learning plan.
A proposed time is reserved only after the learner confirms that exact slot and the server rechecks conflicts.
Only teacher-approved material is available to students for lessons.
Critical / unknown / failed recovery and controlled corpus, index, configuration, permission or archive changes require Founder approval.
Technical Manager may perform only predefined low-risk reversible recovery without a new Founder decision.
Approval, execution and verification are separate auditable events; failed verification keeps the incident open.
All roles and record scopes are enforced by the backend, independent of visual page navigation.
implementation_note: 20 method/path operations expose only required workflows. The shared Coordinator route still contains 15 required business actions; grouping routes does not eliminate their backend work. UI richness does not add fields, tables or workflows to these records.
